title: Dense N-doped carbon nanotubes with encapsulated Fe nanoparticles directly grown within red brick as a sustainable monolithic electrode for high-performance supercapacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01123J, Paper
Mengjuan Xu, Kaige Xu, Yiming Li, Fang Wang, Zhengguo Zhang, Shixiong Min
A monolithic electrode is developed by growing dense N-doped carbon nanotubes (NCNTs) embedded with Fe nanoparticles within a red brick substrate (Fe@NCNTs/RB) for supercapacitors with high areal capacitance, energy density, and cycling stability.
